about: Peoples: the range a culture's strangers are drawn from (KCHAR.stranger, src/10-rig.js). ancestry: each MakeHuman race share drawn from [lo, hi] (then normalised). skin: colour stops, light to dark; a stranger's tone falls anywhere along them. hair and eyes: the colours drawn from; grey: the age slider value above which hair greys. beard: odds a man wears one. morph: a slider drawn from [lo, hi] instead of the default spread. styles: hair ids drawn first (three times in four) per body. Sources: LORE.md section 6 and 7, and the owner's notes (Chichani: ashen-brown skin, dark hair; Beast Riders: vaguely Asiatic or Amerindian, blond to brown hair). Chichani eyes run to amber and red (night vision, after the Dunmer); a proposal. The rest are proposals from each culture's real-world references; change them freely. outfits: per body, per tier, the clothes (torso, legs, feet) a people's strangers wear, and the body mods a tier has (mods: a temple guard's second pair of arms); mods (of a people): the mods all its strangers have (the Hykkousoi's rib gills, tools/mods.py); a four-armed tier wears a four-armed top (KCHAR.fits); tiers: [tier, share] in draw order (KCHAR.stranger). style_share: the share of strangers whose hair is one of its styles (0.75 when absent; 1: only its styles). coat: a furred people's coat (data/fur.json coats), every stranger's.

Spans Old-Style Heartland Shim/Driyan/Azoth (including Azoth's House-Dres Blïtrit slave-estates & Shumar/Dalab marcher-wardens) and New Inner-Crater Voth/Almua/Zey'danin/Temple Canton (Ordinators, Solar Janissaries, High Priests, Grey Penitents, and Sovereign Tzintzun; 16 tiers at 100% M/F parity; tools/garments/cultures/vothic.py).

Not dwarves: no beards, braids or axes. Body (the owner): 0.94 of a human, compact, long strong fingers, very large eyes with eyeshine, colourless pale skin, fine colourless hair cropped short, bare faces. Here: the height slider's low end, a little muscle, the eye-size slider's top, the palest skin and hair stops, cropped styles only, no beards. Owed, not faked: the eyeshine, the fingers' length, eyes larger than the morph's end, an exact 0.94 (TUNGANG-OUTFITS.md). Clothes: tools/garments/cultures/tungang.py; rank is shine (the steward's bead stripes), and the goggles are up in the holds and down on the surface (the crew_surface tier)

peoples.note: Polyglot 1.93–2.0 atm Ring Sea maritime crews across three interlocking strata — blue-water merchant & Port Mira truce-port sailors, De Xedaz / Shanty / Boiling-Bay Brimstone cove-smugglers & false-beacon wreckers, and Hooked-Sun freebooters of Hookfleet & Noah's Regret — including Admiral Vasko Marxal's PF-01 Restorationists and Dread Admiral Bloody Ruephus.

peoples.name: Screamers of the Hexahedron
peoples.note: Feral non-verbal screaming & captive-taking broods dwelling inside and beneath the 1,100-m Hexahedron double-pyramid arcology and Fort Kalor ruin — Talk-Good Elders (salvaged hex-chimes & loudspeaker mitres), Howl-Culm (whistling dorsal bamboo reed-organs & capture-nets), Rust-Skull (scrap-iron megaphone jaw-masks & jagged rebar plate), and Scald-Mist (Steampits steam-whistle helmets & sulfur-vent hide wraps).

peoples.name: Lizardmen
peoples.note: Hypertropic ectothermic saurian autarky of the Great Rift (LORE.md §6.20): six biological size/role castes at 1.25x scale wearing reptile heads and counterbalancing tails (`mod_head_lizard`, `mod_tail`). Zero trade, zero iron/steel, and zero woven cloth — all regalia and panoply are archaic Shang/Zhou verdigris cast bronze (`leiwen` thunder-spirals, `whorl` coils, `taotie` masks), oxblood & ebony beetle-wing lacquer, butchered hexapod chitin, carved bone, and bundled marsh-reed (6 castes at 100% M/F parity; tools/garments/cultures/lizardmen.py).

peoples.name: Frogmen
peoples.note: Batrachian Confederacies of the SW Highlands (`Jrrmiah`, `Trrmb-Pillar`, `Krrmt`, `Rrrmk-Spring` — LORE.md §6.22): compact 0.95x plantigrade amphibians (`mod_head_frog` with dorsal eye turrets, gular vocal pouch, and webbed hands) respiring partly through brush-oiled skin. Dressed in `bead-cone` cocoon silk, `opal-shell` ammolite mosaic, wet-sphagnum hydration cuffs, polypore bracket leather, flooded-bore `ancient-alloys`, and `Span` Thunderdome prize-bronze (14 M/F paired tiers; tools/garments/cultures/frogmen.py).

peoples.name: Captives, Gladiators & Manhunters
peoples.note: Cross-cutting enslaved castes, arena fighters, and manhunters across the continent: Voth's 74,000 Shim Blïtrit blood-reed thralls, Nazar salvage chain-gangs, and solstice sun-altar captives; Ring Sea galley oar-thralls; Span megafauna-bone myrmillos, Drum Cauldron scrap-pitfighters, Arena Hill retiarii and laurelled champions; plus coffle slave-catchers and chartered Seal-warrant bounty hunters.

peoples.name: Hazmat Delvers, Cryo-Sleepers & Civic Trades
peoples.note: Cross-cutting environmental survival gear, vault sleepers, and universal settlement trades: 0.48-atm hypobaric pass rebreathers, Valley Faraday/lead-glass delvers, pH-2.5 fumarole acid suits, Blade biogel-quarantine plague physicians, Tethis 12-bolt copper hard-hat divers, thawed cryo-vault sleepers, and seven universal civic trade overlays (blacksmith, butcher-tanner, baker-brewer, innkeeper, stevedore, chirurgeon, and ossuary undertaker).

peoples.name: Ruin Mutants, Ghouls & Anomaly Cultists
peoples.note: Dungeon aberrations, bio-vat escapees, and forbidden-signal cultists haunting Ancient ruins, karst caves, and dead-zones: ruptured biogel vat-brutes, polypore spore-husk shamblers, Ancient's Valley radiation ghouls, Tethis barnacle-drowned spawn, RC-6 Starlight-Call zealots, entropy-calcified Stilled-Ground husks, rogue Lab-AI wire-cultists, and defaced eclipse sun-heretics.
